basis: Brain, retinal and renal disease define this subtype; hepatic fibrosis in 5/5 and cirrhosis in 3/4. Anemia (5/5) omitted because of the cap.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with universal developmental, motor and speech delay; ocular and joint abnormalities are below 30%.
Inflammatory hypophysitis involves and damages the anterior pituitary; immune-mediated inflammation supports the mechanism axis.
Pyrimidine synthesis defect causes anemia and T-cell dysfunction (30-79%); developmental delay 80-99%. Ureter, hip and cardiac findings omitted by cap.
Prenatal serine synthesis deficiency with severe brain malformations and ichthyosis; characteristic limb malformations and contractures occur commonly (>30%).
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss, documented in 9/9 patients.
Glycosylation disorder defined by muscular dystrophy, intellectual disability and epilepsy; optic atrophy is frequent (30-79%). Hepatic findings are below 30%.
Fanconi subtype; radial defects, CNS malformations and anal atresia each reported in 1/1 annotated patients. Microphthalmia omitted by cap; evidence is sparse.
Hereditary gallbladder disease; gallbladder belongs to the hepatic axis.
Neuronal migration disorder with seizures and developmental delay; persistent strabismus reported in 1/1 patient, with limited frequency evidence.
Axonal sensorimotor neuropathy; chronic muscle atrophy from denervation and arrhythmia are each annotated frequent (30-79%).
Folate transport defect with immunodeficiency and megaloblastic anemia; developmental delay 3/4, delayed myelination 2/2. Oral ulcers 4/4 and skin ulcers 2/4 omitted by cap.
Carcinoma originates in the gallbladder, which belongs to the hepatic axis.
Benign smooth muscle tumor occupying the orbit; orbital vessel-wall origin does not establish a separate cardiovascular disorder.
Defining cleft lip/palate and oligodontia affect oral structures; syndactyly affects digits and pili torti affects hair.
Uterine obstetric disorder lies outside the axes; associated postpartum hemorrhage does not establish a blood-cell or coagulation disease.
Carcinoma in situ is located in the eye.
Autoimmune destruction and atrophy of the thyroid cause hypothyroidism.
Meningioma affects the trigeminal ganglion, a peripheral nervous system structure.
Steroid-sensitive idiopathic nephrotic syndrome is an immune-mediated podocytopathy; focal segmental sclerosis directly damages renal glomeruli.
Mixed phenotype acute leukemia is a blood and marrow malignancy; the lymphoma grandparent does not describe this concept.
Inherited platelet P2Y12 receptor dysfunction impairs aggregation; bruising and mucosal bleeding do not establish additional organ damage.
Recurrent subcutaneous edema defines the disorder. Bowel and airway edema are transient; bradykinin-mediated disease does not itself establish immunodeficiency or autoimmunity.
Hereditary cleavage of the iris pigment layer is an ocular structural disorder.
Metabolic enzyme deficiency; muscle injury supported by elevated CK (80-99%) and myoglobinuria (30-79%); palmoplantar hyperkeratosis 30-79%. Renal insufficiency below 30%.
